summary: Pixel disc showing an agent's state (idle, listening, thinking, working, error, done), dissolving cell by cell between states.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Agent state; an unknown value shows `thinking`. Changing it dissolves to the new state without firing `change`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the state changes through a click, a key or `set()`; not for the initial state or a change of the `state` attribute.

methods.description: Switches to one of the six states and fires `change`. Unknown values and the current state are ignored.

properties.name: state
properties.description: The current state: `idle`, `listening`, `thinking`, `working`, `error` or `done`. Setting it works like `set()`.

accessibility: The orb canvas is focusable (`tabindex="0"`) with `role="button"` and `aria-label="Agent status: <State>. Click to cycle."`, updated on every change.
The state name under the orb is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
Each state button carries `aria-pressed` for the current state.
motion: With reduced motion, a new state replaces the old one at once instead of dissolving pixel by pixel, and each state is shown as a still frame.
notes: The orb canvas is a fixed 164 by 164px and is followed by one button per state.

data.note: Set the agent's state with `state`. Without it the orb starts at `thinking`.
